scope: Statement-level interfaces for the frozen manuscript and the current strict-Conway companions. The map records family, level and premise compatibility; it does not verify the written analytic or geometric proofs.

assumptions.marked_sphere: A fixed finite simple triangulated sphere with at least four vertices, its actual perfect dual matching, and a nonmatching marked edge; retain cyclic orders and primitive crossing-disk framings.
assumptions.fixed_data: The whole diagram, retained half twists and integer crossing powers are fixed before N tends to infinity. The invariant and framing use the recorded original normalization.
assumptions.long_twists: The absolute value of each signed auxiliary filling integer exceeds a threshold depending on the fixed diagram and hypotheses. The signs are independent. This is not a bound uniform in a growing family of diagrams.
assumptions.knot_pairing: The original strand connections give one knot, with no internally closed extra main component.
assumptions.weak_balance: The actual complete packing satisfies every inequality in (wb:balance), or the separately quantified small-defect criterion.
assumptions.protected_inputs: A fixed finite protected triangular assembly as in Appendix Q. Every input has a strict shared-weight certificate for every locally allowed noncentral string, even if its old global coefficient vanishes.
assumptions.ordinary_boundary_inputs: A fixed finite assembly as in Appendix R: unabridged block certificates, distinct selected core matching pairs with all-ordinary triangular boundaries, and positive boundary ratios sufficiently small at every selected core witness and at its complete vector.
assumptions.recursive_construction: The completed-box grammar of Definition def:grammar, with two completed children at the cylindrical root; preserve endpoint order, disk framings, and the fixed half-twist pattern.
assumptions.ordered_circle_tree: The literal finite ordered tree with at least one edge and an original crossing circle at every vertex; every tree edge is a physical quarter-turn and all strand and disk frames are retained.
assumptions.summed_tree_criterion: The actual fixed ordered tree satisfies sum_v d_v/(d_v^2+n_v^2) <= 2^(-25). This is a sufficient criterion, not an assertion for arbitrary short powers.
assumptions.local_tree_criterion: The actual fixed ordered tree satisfies max_v d_v/(d_v^2+n_v^2) <= 2^(-120). The geometry and analytic induction use this same tree and these same powers.
assumptions.directed_tree_criterion: The fixed rooted ordered tree has the complete directed certificate of Appendix K, including the conditional rectangle, every outgoing decay requirement and the separate final-root condition. The degree-or-twist test is a proved sufficient special case.
assumptions.terminal_decoration: The actual finite terminal insertions of Appendix L have been made on both sides of every original region with their required parities. All original and added powers are subject to the final long-twist threshold; the knot can change.
assumptions.strict_conway_construction: A fixed literal ordered Conway expression with at least two distinct leaves, strict leaf/product inequalities and complementary closing outputs. Original turns, crossing disks, primitive framings and all internal components are retained.

exact_source.statement: The reduced marked contraction is the original invariant. Its source has degree at most N-1 in each spectral variable; the scalar and framing factors are retained.

supporting_locations.scope: Only the exponent-support implication after the actual face grid, residue selection and total-degree bound are supplied; physical grid construction and scalar normalization remain written inputs.

Canonical polynomial-resolvent reproduction for a supplied split monic annihilator in the commutative algebra generated by one local operator; the original Casimir, crossing jets and diagram correspondence remain written inputs.

Written exact Fourier similarity of the original pair Casimir with the polynomial face operator, deriving the annihilator and the local homogeneous adapter, including integer endpoint and displacement conditions.

supporting_locations.anchor: ## 3. The published enhancement and every braid word
supporting_locations.scope: Written finite crossing and enhancement comparison with the specified literature Kashaev convention; its global use retains the original turns, reduced mark and framing normalization.

complete_packing.statement: The original augmented diagram has the labeled positive complete packing and its absolute source-volume anchor.

central_local_estimates.statement: The exact central source has the relative holomorphic estimate and the global central spectral gap, with odd normals and both native parity anchors retained.

central_contribution.statement: For independently sufficiently long fixed signed twists, the entire central Fourier period has a nonzero subexponential amplitude at the selected action. Its action tends to the complete action as the fixed twists lengthen.

specified_metric.statement: The original primitive auxiliary slopes complete smoothly to the complement of the specified filled knot; its main cusp remains complete.

absolute_volume.statement: The calibrated action, including the filling boundary correction, equals the volume of the same oriented completed metric divided by 2 pi.

filling_norm.statement: The exact filling functional has norm at most the product of 1+|n_e|/2 on the canonical polynomial of degree at most N-1 in each variable.

weak_balance_source_gap.statement: Under the actual complete-packing inequalities, one common perturbation of weights gives a strict rate gap for the entire complementary polynomial on the full spectral cube.

weak_balance_remainder.statement: Apply the finite filling norm to the whole complementary polynomial. Increase the long-twist threshold after fixing its positive source gap, so the filled-action drop is smaller than that gap.

protected_certificate.statement: The protected triangular sum transports certificates for every locally allowed noncentral sector, with one common set of weights per string and exact cancellation of the duplicated ordinary target.

protected_remainder.statement: The finite unabridged sector cover bounds the entire complementary polynomial. The exact filling norm transfers the gap; the fixed twist threshold makes it larger than the filled-action drop.

rate_transfer.statement: A nonzero leading term with subexponential scalar and amplitude cannot be cancelled by a full remainder with a strictly smaller exponential rate.

weak_balance_volume.statement: All-level volume limit for the unchanged knot under weak balance.

protected_sum_volume.statement: All-level volume limit for any fixed finite protected assembly with the unabridged input certificates and its own knot-component test.

general_geometric_rate.statement: The all-central contribution alone is nonzero and has the actual knot-complement volume rate; this statement does not bound the full invariant.

general_remainder.statement: A strict bound for the entire noncentral filled contribution on a general unchanged matched sphere. Neither the central estimate nor a single-cap estimate supplies this.

general_volume.statement: The full-invariant volume limit for every unchanged matched sphere in the stated geometric setup; this is a target with an unresolved remainder premise.

conditional_disk_action.statement: For every positive boundary triple, the interior action has a unique minimizer and equals the old triangle potential plus the protected complete action. The geometric development gives the conditional root-curvature comparison.

ordinary_boundary_certificate.statement: At small positive boundary ratios the unabridged block certificate extends, including newly allowed sides. The whole-block case split and exact target correction give a strict shared-weight certificate for each noncentral assembled string.

ordinary_boundary_remainder.statement: The phase-uniform source bound covers every complementary string. The exact filling norm and a sufficiently small filled-action drop give a strict bound for the entire filled remainder.

ordinary_boundary_volume.statement: All-level full-invariant volume limit for the fixed ordinary-boundary assembly and its own knot-component test. All sufficiently long final signed twist powers are fixed before the level limit.

recursive_source.statement: The exact reduced scalar for the fixed completed tangle expression is the original invariant, with the full core/alias split, crossing powers, turns, traces and normalization retained.

recursive_leading.statement: The original filled Fourier sum has a nonzero leading amplitude for independently sufficiently long fixed signed twists, with both parities retained.

supporting_locations.scope: The local holomorphic packet is a prerequisite, not the full Fourier remainder estimate.

recursive_remainder.statement: The complementary colors, aliases, nonleading Fourier charges, tails and contour connectors are bounded below the same filled leading action.

supporting_locations.scope: The entire complementary-color estimate before filling.

recursive_metric.statement: The labeled positive cells complete along the original primitive slopes to the specified hyperbolic knot complement, leaving its main cusp complete.

recursive_absolute_volume.statement: The marked regulator, its boundary correction and its absolute complete anchor give the volume of that same completed knot metric.

recursive_volume.statement: The original all-level Kashaev volume limit for the completed recursive class and its independently long fixed signed fillings.

circle_tree_source.statement: The full Newton edge kernel and marked trace contraction evaluate the original reduced invariant of the literal ordered circle tree, including every index and repeated-root normal.

summed_tree_leading.statement: Under its stated criterion the original tree contraction has a nonzero leading term, with exact child scalars and both level parities retained.

summed_tree_remainder.statement: The criterion controls the whole original complementary contraction, including all conditional trace tails and contour connectors relative to the retained leading action.

summed_tree_path.statement: The same criterion places the restored joint stationary point on the positive geometric charge path with the required radius and peripheral sign bounds.

summed_tree_absolute_volume.statement: The absolute regulator of the same oriented cell chain equals the volume of the completed metric, including the original half-twist correction.

decorated_source_gap.statement: The prescribed actual terminal insertions make the shared packing inequalities strict and bound every noncentral sector of the resulting original source.

decorated_remainder.statement: The complete signed Fourier remainder of the decorated diagram is smaller than its nonzero geometric contribution once every original and added fixed twist is sufficiently long.

decorated_volume.statement: The all-level volume identity for the actual decorated knot; the theorem does not identify it with the undeformed core knot.

strict_conway_source.statement: Exact expansion of each full integer crossing power in ordinary colored circles and original reduced Kashaev normalization, at N>=3. The omitted finite initial level does not affect an all-integer-level limit.

supporting_locations.scope: Original enhancement, single cut and framing normalization; not a large-level estimate.

strict_conway_variational.statement: The original primitive wire lattice has a unique strict maximum with negative definite Hessian, including two leaves. Its boundary profiles are obtained without a global metric or a signed-source asymptotic.

supporting_locations.scope: Independent integer coordinates and their primitive lattice, including all original affine offsets.

strict_conway_gap_many.statement: For at least three leaves, the whole-source upper bound, physical-color deficit gap and entire source-minus-core gap hold at all sufficiently large levels. This is the H>=3 case of the final H>=2 argument.

strict_conway_gap_two.statement: For exactly two leaves, the separate original pairing proof gives the same whole-source, physical-color and source-minus-core gaps at rate twice the leaf maximum.

strict_conway_source_gap.statement: The two-leaf and at-least-three-leaf cases together supply the complete physical-color and full-minus-core estimates for every strict expression with at least two leaves.

strict_conway_pure_window.statement: Exact canonical factorial interpolation on the primitive grid gives a nonzero holomorphic pure-window expansion at every strict leaf index, including quarter. The original physical complement is exponentially bounded.

supporting_locations.scope: Canonical sine-factorial continuation agreeing exactly with integer factorials; no signed recurrence input.

strict_conway_fourier.statement: The actual finite Fourier polynomial has the required separate degree, a nonzero local amplitude with real pure action, and a shared complex-strip gap on the whole torus.

strict_conway_leading.statement: The whole-period theorem applied to that exact pure polynomial gives the nonzero filled leading term, including both parities, all signed integer powers, all Fourier charges and endpoint currents.

strict_conway_metric.statement: The original marked strict exterior has smooth primitive signed fillings with all main cusps complete, on the specified knot complement. Its classical proof has no quantum asymptotic premise.
